subject: Launch subsidy waiver request — OrbitAI accelerator cohort
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan@orbitai.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha@orbitai.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: launch subsidy + packaging ask for OrbitAI cohort

Hi Naomi + Ben —

Thanks again for the great demo last week. OrbitAI is part of a June accelerator cohort that starts onboarding next month; we’re live-testing an MVP with ten pilot customers and expect spiky usage in week 1. We’re excited about Redwood — your latency/throughput profile checks a lot of boxes for what we need.

Quick ask: the accelerator requires partners to provide a small launch subsidy to participants (either credits or short-term discounts). Given our early revenue runway we’re seeking a promotional package of $20k in Redwood credits for the cohort (to be redeemed across the ten pilots over 90 days) plus a short-term technical onboarding credit to cover higher initial token usage.

Why this matters:
- We estimate 1.2M tokens during the 90-day pilot across the cohort (see attached usage report).
- This cohort is tightly networked with three VC firms who often recommend platform choices to their portfolio — there is clear logo + pipeline upside.
- We view this as a testbed to convert to a reserved commit in Q4 if the pilots show traction.

Would Redwood consider an exception to the standard accelerator promo (we know your program caps are usually lower)? If full $20k is not possible, a split approach (e.g., $10k credits + documented conversion path to a dedicated discount) could work.

Attached: OrbitAI_MVP_usage_report.pdf (estimates, instrumentation)

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through numbers.

Best,
Ethan Cole
Co-founder, OrbitAI
ethan@orbitai.ai | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: OrbitAI_MVP_usage_report.pdf (2.1MB)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan@orbitai.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: launch subsidy + packaging ask for OrbitAI cohort

Ethan —

Thanks for the clear ask and the usage attachment. Congrats on getting the cohort together, sounds promising. A few initial notes from our side:

1) Program guardrails: our standard accelerator sweetener is usually $5k–10k in credits for cohort partners. Anything above that requires a delegated approval and a concrete conversion trigger (we need a path to Reserved/Dedicated or a marketing commitment).

2) Proposal we can consider: conditional $10k credits up front + a $10k credit hold that releases if OrbitAI converts >= $2k/month committed spend within 120 days, or if three pilots roll into paid paid seats. Alternatively, we can do $15k credits + conversion commitment with a 20% conversion discount on the first month of Dedicated for pilots that convert.

3) Operational asks: we’ll need a short MOU that defines redemption rules (per-pilot caps, no rollover after 90 days, telemetry requirements) and a basic exec sponsor from OrbitAI to surface conversion outcomes.

Ben / Mina / Irene — can you run a quick impact calc and draft an MOU stub? Ben, please flag any revenue ops constraints. Mina, can you confirm the marketing consideration (co-marketing, logo placement) to justify stretch? Irene, can you weigh in on whether Legal needs anything special for this cohort (terms, tax treatment)?

Ethan — we’re open to making a one-time exception for the right conversion/growth guarantees. Let’s aim to get a short MOU and an internal decision this week. If you’re available, Ben and I can hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow to finalize structure.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan@orbitai.ai>, Aisha Khan <aisha@orbitai.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: launch subsidy + packaging ask for OrbitAI cohort

Naomi / team / Ethan —

I ran a quick financial on the $10k / conditional $10k structure Naomi outlined. High level:
- If we approve $10k upfront + $10k contingent, expected gross usage credits redeemed ~ $8.9k given OrbitAI's estimates (1.2M tokens @ Redwood hosted rates).
- Upside: cohort logos + potential reserveds. Downside: if pilots don’t convert, we absorb ~ $10k credit but exposure is acceptable for marketing ROI.

Attached is a draft MOU (MOU-draft.docx) that captures redemption rules, per-pilot cap ($2k/pilot), telemetry obligations, and the conversion trigger (three pilots convert to paid or $2k/mo committed within 120 days). Also included a soft 90-day expiry and a clause that any Dedicated discount offered on conversion is applied only to first billing period.

Operational asks: we should require a single OrbitAI exec sponsor and a co-marketing commitment (1 blog + 2 joint socials) to justify stretch. If Legal signs off, Revenue Ops will need to map the credits to the OrbitAI account and create a tracking tag for any conversion.

Ethan — can you confirm the exec sponsor and marketing deliverables? If yes, I can route this to RevOps and Legal for sign-off today.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0188

[Attachment: MOU-draft.docx]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Jun 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: launch subsidy + packaging ask for OrbitAI cohort

Forwarding to Finance & Legal for final sign-off — I’m comfortable approving the pilot subsidy as an exception contingent on the MOU terms.

Notes for reviewers:
- Approve $10k immediate credit + $10k contingent hold.
- Require per-pilot cap of $2k, 90-day expiry, telemetry proof to redeem the contingent hold.
- Marketing: require OrbitAI to commit to at least one co-marketing case study within 6 months.
- Legal: please ensure the MOU contains clear tax treatment language (credit is a promotional discount, not cash consideration) and that we include an IP/usage clause for telemetry sharing.

Ben — please route the MOU to Revenue Ops (cc: revops@redwood.ai) and Legal (cc: legal@redwood.ai). If both sign off, we’ll execute the credits and confirm with OrbitAI.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Go-to-Market Programs, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0134
